memory_candidates.content: To make an extended language's proof system inherit every base-language axiom schema instantiated over the extended language, do not re-prove the schemata: if the new operator's formulas are state formulas (truth depends only on the world state), define an injective encoding Atom ⊕ ExtFormula → Atom, an atomize map replacing each maximal new-operator subformula by a fresh atom, and a model on the same frame whose valuation at the fresh atom is the new-operator truth at that state; one transfer lemma plus the landed per-axiom validity lemmas then discharge all schemata, validity and swap-validity alike (swap-validity needs atomize e (φ.swap) = (atomize (e ∘ Sum.map id swap) φ).swap).

In this tree temporal_duality soundness is the companion recursion derivable_valid_and_swap_validIn (Soundness.lean:1217) with a per-constructor swap-validity dispatch (axiom_swap_validIn_min, :1190); TruthAntiIso/truthAt_of_truthAntiIso is used only in Metalogic/Independence/CoNotPriorU.lean, never on the soundness path. New languages should mirror the companion recursion, not build an anti-iso.
